name: Handling Money
overview: Scripture teaches that handling money wisely honors the Lord and requires diligent stewardship. Believers are called to honor God with their wealth and firstfruits, recognizing that trusting in riches leads to downfall while righteousness brings flourishing. Wealth gained through honest labor increases, whereas foolish spending depletes resources. Additionally, Scripture warns against debt, highlighting that borrowers become servants to lenders, and encourages careful oversight of one’s possessions to ensure wise management.
